QuestionStmt.S: Calculate the total number of tetrahedral and octahedral voids formed in 0.6 mol of a compound if it forms hcp structure.

Solution.S:
Number of atoms in 0.6 mol:

$$n = 0.6 \times 6.022 \times 10^{23} = 3.6132 \times 10^{23} \text{ atoms}$$

In hcp structure:

$$\text{Octahedral voids} = \text{Number of atoms} = 3.6132 \times 10^{23}$$

$$\text{Tetrahedral voids} = 2 \times \text{Number of atoms} = 2 \times 3.6132 \times 10^{23} = 7.2264 \times 10^{23}$$

Total voids:

$$= 7.2264 \times 10^{23} + 3.6132 \times 10^{23} = 10.8396 \times 10^{23} = 1.084 \times 10^{24}$$

Thus the correct option is C.
